# Illustration of Data Simulation

```{r}
#| label: fig-sim-illustration
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 3.5

set.seed(4271)

pop_cors <- c(-.7, 0, .7)
N        <- 90

plots <- lapply(pop_cors, function(rho) {

  x <- rnorm(N)
  y <- x * rho + rnorm(N) * sqrt(1 - rho^2)

  r  <- cor(x, y)
  df <- data.frame(x = x, y = y)

  ggplot(df, aes(x, y)) +
    geom_point() +
    labs(
      x     = 'Data "x"',
      y     = 'Data "y"',
      title = sprintf("Correlation = %.2f", r)
    )
})

wrap_plots(plots, nrow = 1)
```

# Correlations Can Mislead

```{r}
#| label: fig-misleading-cors
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 3.5

N <- 90

make_shape <- function(shape_id) {

  if (shape_id == 1) {
    theta <- seq(0, 2 * pi, length.out = N + 1)[-(N + 1)]
    x <- cos(theta)
    y <- sin(theta)

  } else if (shape_id == 2) {
    x <- seq(-2, 2, length.out = N)
    y <- x^2

  } else {
    half <- seq(-2, 2, length.out = N %/% 2)
    x <- c(half, half)
    y <- c(half, -half)
  }

  r <- cor(x, y)
  data.frame(x = x, y = y, r = r, shape = shape_id)
}

shapes <- lapply(1:3, make_shape)

plots <- lapply(shapes, function(df) {
  ggplot(df, aes(x, y)) +
    geom_point() +
    labs(title = sprintf("r = %.2f", df$r[1])) +
    theme(axis.text = element_blank(), axis.ticks = element_blank(),
          axis.title = element_blank())
})

wrap_plots(plots, nrow = 1)
```

# Systematic Comparison of Correlation and Cosine Similarity

```{r}
#| label: fig-systematic-comparison
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 4

set.seed(8813)

pop_rs <- seq(-1, 1, length.out = 100)
N      <- 500

results <- lapply(pop_rs, function(rho) {

  x <- rnorm(N)
  y <- x * rho + rnorm(N) * sqrt(1 - rho^2)

  x <- x - 10  # mean offset

  # Pearson correlation (manual formula)
  x_c  <- x - mean(x)
  y_c  <- y - mean(y)
  x_ss <- sum(x_c^2)
  y_ss <- sum(y_c^2)
  r    <- sum(x_c * y_c) / sqrt(x_ss * y_ss)

  # Cosine similarity (manual formula)
  x_ss2 <- sum(x^2)
  y_ss2 <- sum(y^2)
  cos_s <- sum(x * y) / sqrt(x_ss2 * y_ss2)

  data.frame(pop_r = rho, pearson = r, cosine = cos_s)
})

res <- do.call(rbind, results)

p1 <- ggplot(res, aes(x = pop_r)) +
  geom_point(aes(y = pearson, shape = "Correlation")) +
  geom_point(aes(y = cosine,  shape = "Cosine sim.")) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray60") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray60") +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("Correlation" = 15, "Cosine sim." = 16)) +
  labs(
    x     = "Population correlation",
    y     = expression("Measured " * italic(r) * " or " * italic(S[C])),
    title = "Correlation and cosine sim.",
    shape = NULL
  )

r_between <- cor(res$pearson, res$cosine)

p2 <- ggplot(res, aes(x = pearson, y = cosine)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray60") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray60") +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-1.1, 1.1), ylim = c(-1.1, 1.1)) +
  labs(
    x     = "Correlation",
    y     = "Cosine similarity",
    title = sprintf("r = %.2f", r_between)
  )

p1 | p2
```
